scope: Integrated master86/shared-cache/standalone-claim-repair source; device correctness only, not a relabeling of the earlier endpoint timings.
script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /data/jzzeng/qc-pbe0-resident-ao-pr-20261003
source /home/jzzeng/codes/qc-pbe0-generated-sources-20261003/.artifacts/gpu-environment.sh
: "${SLURM_JOB_ID:?requires finite Slurm}"
export GENERATIVEQC_LIBRARY="$PWD/.artifacts/candidate/libgenerativeqc.so"
export GENERATIVEQC_GRID_CUDA_TEST=1
export GENERATIVEQC_CLAIM_CUDA_TEST=1
export CCACHE_BASEDIR="$PWD"
export TMPDIR="$PWD/.artifacts/test-tmp"
mkdir -p "$TMPDIR"
printf 'job=%s host=%s devices=%s\n' "$SLURM_JOB_ID" "$(hostname)" "$CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"
nvidia-smi -q
ccache --version
ccache --show-stats
trap 'ccache --show-stats' EXIT
sha256sum -c .artifacts/candidate/library.sha256
"$python" - <<'PY'
import ctypes
from pathlib import Path
from generativeqc.autotune import source_identity
root = Path.cwd()
library = ctypes.CDLL(str(root / '.artifacts/candidate/libgenerativeqc.so'))
library.generativeqc_get_source_identity.restype = ctypes.c_char_p
compiled = library.generativeqc_get_source_identity().decode()
assert compiled == source_identity(root) == (root / '.artifacts/source-identity.txt').read_text().strip()
print('SOURCE IDENTITY PASS', compiled)
PY
"$python" -m pytest -q --tb=short tests/python/test_resident_ao_selection.py tests/python/test_resident_ao_map_cache.py tests/python/test_stationary_resident_ao_maps.py
compute-sanitizer --tool memcheck --error-exitcode 91 \
  "$python" -m pytest -q --tb=short tests/python/test_resident_ao_selection.py

"$python" -m pytest -q --tb=short tests/python/test_bounded_force_claim_cuda.py
